description: Land Title Settlement Department - Yonganmulla, Mahara D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510801
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extent measurements, owner names and identities, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements.
